result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional. The horizontally scrollable category chips and restaurant carousel with partially visible edge items, as well as the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport, are intended features and not defects. One minor content issue was found: a spelling error in the search placeholder text.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restarants' is misspelled (should be 'Restaurants').
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.
